lines: [excited] [fast] Two hundred seventy-five billion dollars in hundred-dollar bills!
[fast] That's what Americans are expected to spend online by New Year's.
[deadpan] One bill is four thousandths of an inch thick. Basically nothing.
[building suspense] Now stack two point seven five billion of them. Past the clouds.
[shocked] Past Mount Everest. Almost thirty-four Everests tall!
[excited] At sixty-two miles it hits the edge of space. And it keeps going.
[whisper] It finally stops at about a hundred eighty-seven miles.
[deadpan] It weighs around three thousand tons. Free shipping, obviously.
[sly] And all of it starts with one tiny button. Add to cart.
